title: aster arenarius f. albiflorus
intro: Aster arenarius f. albiflorus, commonly known as the White Sea Aster, is a flowering plant species within the daisy family, known for its delicate white blooms. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it effective in soothing wounds, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which help to clear mucus from the respiratory tract, reduce inflammation, and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of Aster arenarius f. albiflorus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
